name: Anime school
description: A sunlit high school in cherry-blossom season: navy and cream, and a spiral notebook for every conversation.

text.headquarters-empty: The classroom is empty: no coordinator is running.
text.register-greeting: {here} asleep here{upstairs}. Who shall I wake, dear?
text.register-empty: Every futon is folded away: nobody is sleeping tonight.
text.letter-for-sleeper: {name} is asleep in the dormitory: the letter waits until it wakes.
text.rookery-empty: Nothing has been posted today. Shall I post one for you?
text.end-session-after: Its pane closes and it goes to the dormitory to sleep; you can wake it there.
text.session-ended: {name}'s session ended; it goes to the dormitory to sleep.
text.conversation-asleep: {name} is asleep in the dormitory. Wake it to talk; it opens in a new terminal window.
text.quest-greeting: {count} requests are addressed to you! Pick one, or look through the whole file.
text.quest-greeting-one: One request is addressed to you! Or look through the whole file.
text.quest-empty: No requests for you today. The council file has all the others.
text.quest-signed-out: I can't open the council files without your Atlassian sign-in. You can add it in Settings!
text.quest-search: Search every request by words or key
text.library-greeting: Welcome to the library! What would you like to look up?
text.library-signed-out: Please sign in to Atlassian in Settings first, then I can find any page for you.
text.library-recent-empty: Pages you read here are noted on your library card.
text.crier-greeting: This is the broadcast club! {count} channels have news. Tell me any channel and I'll read it out!
text.crier-quiet: No news right now! Tell me any channel and I'll read it out.
text.crier-signed-out: The broadcast room isn't tuned in to Slack yet. Sign in and I can read out any channel!
text.forge-greeting: All of these are yours or your classmates'! Which one shall we look at?
text.forge-empty: The benches are empty: nothing of yours or your classmates' is open on GitHub.
text.forge-loading: Let's see what's on the benches…

pet.name: Calico cat
pet.examine: {name}, the school's calico. Officially a club member.

sleeper.name: Sleeping calico
sleeper.examine: A calico curled up in the sun, purring in its sleep.

bell.name: School bell
bell.examine: A brass bell on a wooden frame, with a red tassel.

light.name: Paper lantern
light.examine: A paper lantern painted with cherry blossoms.

box.name: Bento box
box.examine: A wooden bento tied with a blossom band. Not yours. Probably.

candle.name: Desk lamp
candle.examine: A green banker's lamp, glowing softly.

tome.name: Notebook
tome.examine: Someone's class notebook, full of doodles in the margins.
lines: "A doodle of the calico, labelled: Club President."

spin.name: Goldfish bowl
spin.examine: A round goldfish bowl on a little stand. The goldfish is called Kingyo.
